fusions.name: Costly Word
fusions.desc: Speaks a word that costs 4% of your maximum health and sends a bolt into the first enemy it meets, dealing 8 dark damage. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Perfect Recital
fusions.desc: Looses 3 pulses in a spread, each dealing 25 resonating damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Quickened Tongue
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Rhythm
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 10% sooner.
